gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-schibsted-: Schibsted Grotesk draws big, open-looking e and a shapes with tall bowls, friendly and easy to settle into. And Electroharmonix in the heading splits each word into separate letters, a loud, commanding start before the friendlier text.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-sen: Sharp and spaced out: Electroharmonix breaks each word into single letters with open-handed curves. Sen follows with tall lowercase drawn at constant weight, so whole paragraphs would glide along without snagging.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-sofia-sans: Loud and loose: Electroharmonix splits words into single letters, while Sofia Sans Semi Condensed holds lowercase near capital height. The main draw is the gap between loud spacing and quiet, uniform strokes.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-tiktok-san: Spaced-out and striking, Electroharmonix breaks words into single letters with open-handed curves. TikTok Sans lifts its lowercase close to cap height, with a spacious c that keeps text modern.
gen-dafont-espresso-dolce-fs-neco: Espresso Dolce writes with a calligraphic hand, its lowercase e wide-eyed. Neco, a serif with a measured hairline-to-stem swell, holds up in brief text, though shrinking the script would dull its neon-tube thickness.
gen-dafont-espresso-dolce-fs-plein: Bent-wire charm: Espresso Dolce is a script that earns its keep big and brief, with a wide-eyed e. Plein, a sans-serif with a clear channel leading into round letters, is not built for endless paragraphs.
gen-dafont-espresso-dolce-outfit: Outfit reads cleanly and approachably, its curves finishing well before they close, though not built for page after page. Espresso Dolce adds a decorative, neon-tube flourish on top.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-aldrich: Aldrich traces every letter like one thick thread, with a tall x-height. Ethnocentric pushes its letters apart and perches short ascenders over big bowls, for a fast, aggressive stance.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-alexandria: Alexandria reads cleanly, with generously opened c terminals and a tall body between short stems. But Ethnocentric, spaced wide with short ascenders above big bowls, is where the speed lives.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-anek-bangla: Anek Bangla reads friendly and contemporary, with wide s curves barely curling inward and a short climb to the ascenders. And after Ethnocentric shouts, the text would glide through paragraphs without any strain.
